question: Gulf Streams emanate from the gulf of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mexico**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Gulf Stream **is a strong ocean stream that transports warm water from **the Gulf of Mexico to the Atlantic**.
 
• It runs the length of the United States and Canada's eastern coasts.
 
• The Gulf Stream is created by an oceanic gyre, which is a huge system of circular currents and intense winds. On Earth, there are five oceanic gyres.
 
• The North Atlantic Subtropical Gyre includes the Gulf Stream. The ocean is always in motion, with currents transporting water from one location to another.
 
• Warm water from the Gulf of Mexico is carried all the way up to the Norwegian Sea by the Gulf Stream.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
